Let me know what options you have!

I’d like to go with flight HAT178 departing at 08:00. Please proceed with changing my return flight to that nonstop ATL to LAS option and upgrade me to economy. Let me know if you need anything else from me!
Yes, I agree with all the changes and the payment arrangement. Please go ahead and make the switch to the nonstop ATL to LAS flight and upgrade my reservation to economy. Thank you!
In that case, could you please transfer me to a supervisor or someone who might be able to help further with this request? Thank you.
